description: Weekly review contract eval. Real weeks are identified by date only: their data is read from the owner's local database at run time and never stored here. Synthetic cases add made-up data on top of a real week, in a throwaway in-memory copy of the database. Why each real week was chosen is kept locally in data/evals/review/real-weeks.md, since it describes the owner.
